slides.title: WhatsApp *Catalog* se order lo. 5 steps.
slides.sub: Customer ko 20 photos bhejna band. Ek link, sab products. Free.

slides.title: 1. Catalog *on karo*
slides.sub: WhatsApp Business app → Business tools → Catalog. 10 minute.
slides.box: Business tools → Catalog → Add new item

slides.title: 2. Har item: *photo + price + 1 line*
slides.sub: Price chhupao mat. "DM for price" = customer chala gaya.

slides.title: 3. *Collections* banao
slides.sub: Category ke hisaab se: "Bestseller", "₹500 ke andar", "Naya".

slides.title: 4. *Link* har jagah
slides.sub: Insta bio, Google profile, quick reply mein catalog link.

slides.title: 5. *Har hafte* update
slides.sub: Stock khatam = item hide. Naya aaya = top pe.

slides.title: Catalog se *orders* nahi aa rahe?
slides.sub: Comment AUDIT, hum free check karke batayenge kya badlo.
